scope: Projected Quality acceptance for the simulated research-use specimen lifecycle and its supporting evidence package.
intended_use: Demonstrate the shape of a complete Quality decision packet for later configured-environment execution and accountable review.
decision_basis: The simulation provides traceable rules, scenarios, execution artifacts, limitations, and re-evaluation triggers.
The projected decision remains separate from organizational Quality authority.

residual_risks.risk: Configured vendor behavior can differ from the emulator projection.
residual_risks.control: Execute the shared conformance suite in the named tenant and bind results to the exact build and configuration.

conditions: Representative migration and restore rehearsals reach observed qualification.
Production security and observability exercises receive accountable review.
